shared_principles: Preserve compatibility and measure quality, safety and performance
Never change original sources or private projects without permission

Separate synthetic success, sampled similarity, causal hypotheses and verified effects
Use relevant tests during work and necessary milestone CI
Keep GitHub canonical and Notion as an actual-status mirror
Do not claim fully autonomous creation or repair of arbitrary addons
